_history: Superseded October 10, 2026. Schema 1 recorded Xenova/all-mpnet-base-v2 at e086c5e0b3a57b0ce46dd6d9c0662948860b35f3 (a pinned revision, Apache-2.0 base card, weights acquired for evidence only). Doug returned the Docker default to the model every existing store uses (Implementation Design section 8, 'Superseded October 10, 2026'; section 11, item 11).
revision_policy: Unpinned on purpose: the Taproom config sets extensions.models.embedding and no embeddingRevision, as on every existing install. The model cache keys a non-main revision under <model>/<revision>/ and an unpinned install under main, so a pin would download the model again into the user's _cache instead of reusing the copy existing stores already hold, and would fail offline.

base_model.revision_note: The revision the Xenova conversion was made from is not recorded by either repository; the head above is the one observed, not a proven lineage point.

conversion.description: ONNX conversion of the sentence-transformers base for Transformers.js. The conversion card says only 'with ONNX weights to be compatible with Transformers.js'.

license.evidence: Neither the Xenova conversion card (front matter: base_model, library_name, pipeline_tag) nor the sentence-transformers base card (front matter: language, library_name, tags, pipeline_tag; no license text) declares a license, and the Hugging Face metadata of both repositories carries no license field. No license text is included in this package because none was found; none is invented.
license.open_question: Redistribution of the weights is not settled, as for DeepFilterNet3 (see packaging/models/dfn3/NOTICE.md). No image, archive or source offer carries these weights: Taproom downloads them from the publisher into <dataRoot>/_cache at the user's installation on first use, as every standalone install already does.

acquisition.hash_note: The five small files' SHA-256 values were computed from copies fetched read-only at the observed head revision. The ONNX graph's SHA-256 is the Git LFS object id Hugging Face reports for it; the file itself was not downloaded for this record.

files_note: The six files of the repository's quantized feature-extraction set. The Transformers.js quantized path requires the config and tokenizer JSON files and onnx/model_quantized.onnx (Packaging-G1-Inputs.md, static trace of sillytavern-transformers 2.14.6); vocab.txt and special_tokens_map.json are the vocabulary and special-token files that complete the set. Taproom downloads what it needs at the user's installation; nothing here is shipped.
